title: Training job resources
description: Per-job CPU, RAM, network, disk and assigned-GPU history. Select a time range covering the run, including for deleted Jobs. Samples start when monitoring is installed; retention is up to seven days or 4 GB. Queued Jobs have no usage until a Pod starts.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU cores used across all job containers. One core equals one CPU-second per second. Requests and limits include only pending/running Pods.

targets.expr: sum((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",resource="cpu"} and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"})))

sum((kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",resource="cpu"} and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"})))

panels.title: RAM usage
panels.description: Working set includes recently used cache; RSS is resident anonymous memory. Requests and limits include only pending/running Pods.

targets.expr: sum((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",resource="memory"} and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"})))

sum((kube_pod_container_resource_limits{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",resource="memory"} and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",phase=~"Pending|Running"} == 1)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"})))

panels.title: CPU throttling
panels.description: Percentage of CPU quota enforcement periods throttled. Empty when no CPU quota is configured.

targets.expr: 100 * sum((rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{job="training-cadvisor",namespace="$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"}))) / sum((rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{job="training-cadvisor",namespace="$namespace",container!="",container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"})))

panels.title: Network traffic
panels.description: Pod network traffic, excluding loopback. Network counters belong to the Pod sandbox, not individual application containers.

targets.expr: sum((max by (namespace, pod, interface) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="training-cadvisor",namespace="$namespace",interface!="lo"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"})))

sum((max by (namespace, pod, interface) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="training-cadvisor",namespace="$namespace",interface!="lo"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"})))

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Container filesystem read/write throughput where exposed by the kubelet. This is not persistent-volume capacity or total dataset size.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: Restarts within each Pod. Pod replacements have separate series; their histories remain available in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"})))

panels.title: Assigned GPU utilization
panels.description: Physical GPU utilization while assigned to this job by the NVIDIA device plugin. This is device telemetry, not per-process attribution.

targets.expr: max by (UUID, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL{job="nvidia-gpu",namespace="$namespace",pod!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"})))

panels.title: Assigned GPU memory
panels.description: Physical framebuffer memory used on GPUs assigned to this job. CPU-only jobs have no GPU series.

targets.expr: max by (UUID, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{job="nvidia-gpu",namespace="$namespace",pod!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"}))) * 1024 * 1024

panels.title: Pod phases
panels.description: Number of job Pods in each phase, including retries that have not yet been deleted.

targets.expr: sum by (phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_owner{job="training-pods",namespace="$namespace",owner_kind="Job",owner_is_controller="true",owner_name="$job_name"})))
